rationale: Describes network visibility components and an engine that processes network context into dashboards of graphs, charts, maps, and statistics about applications, geographies, and devices. These are conventional visibility, data processing, and reporting functions; context-aware wording alone does not establish AI.
evidence_spans: network visibility solutions provides the components of your visibilty archectecture which include the access layer, virtual visibility.
context-aware data processing engine provides administrators with a dashboard of graphs, charts, maps, and statistics of known and unknown applications, geographies, and devices on their network.
